newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Boeing in talks on new Australia hq site.
newsitem.headline: Boeing in talks on new Australia hq site.

text.p: Boeing Co aerospace and defence systems unit Boeing Australia said on Monday that it was talking to some state governments about relocating its headquarter operations.

The company said its current lease at an industrial park in Sydney's northwestern suburbs expired last year and it was now in talks with a number of state governments, including New South Wales of which Sydney is the capital.

Boeing Australia spokesman Tony Hill had been asked to comment on a report in Business Queensland, a weekly newspaper, that the company was looking at relocating to Queensland and would add an Asia/Pacific regional emphasis to its operations.
"It was stated by the managing director of the company (David Gray) some months ago that Asia was certainly an area that we would like to look at down the track," Hill said.
